# Bibliarch

> Bibliarch (https://bibliarch.com) is a free website for writers and creators. It has two tools under one account: Notes, a visual note-taking board for planning stories, worlds and original characters (OCs), and Books, an online book creator that exports print-ready PDFs and EPUBs. It runs in the browser on computers, tablets and phones.

Key facts:

- Price: free to use, supported by optional donations (https://bibliarch.com/donate). An account is required so work can be saved.
- Platform: web only. Nothing to install. There is no offline app.
- Publishing: Bibliarch makes the files. It does not sell or distribute books; users upload files to services like Amazon KDP or IngramSpark themselves. It is not affiliated with those services.

## Tools

- [Bibliarch Notes: visual note-taking app](https://bibliarch.com/note-taking-app): boards of text, sticky notes, characters, locations, events, lists, tables, images and relationship maps. Live collaboration with up to 10 people.
- [Bibliarch Books: online book creator](https://bibliarch.com/book-creator): write on real book pages, design layout and cover, import .docx/.txt/Markdown, export PDF and EPUB, print checks for Amazon KDP and IngramSpark.
- [OC tools](https://bibliarch.com/oc-tools): how to keep original characters organized with profile boards and relationship maps.

## Free resources

- [Things to do with your OCs on Bibliarch](https://bibliarch.com/oc-tools/things-to-do-with-your-ocs): taking notes on original characters, keeping their art and backstory together, mapping relationships, and sharing them.
- [OC profile template](https://bibliarch.com/oc-tools/oc-profile-template): a copy-and-paste character sheet.

## Details

- [About Bibliarch](https://bibliarch.com/about): what it is, who it suits, and when something else is a better fit.
- [Full product description](https://bibliarch.com/llms-full.txt): the complete feature list as plain text.
